page.overview:
Who is Advisor?

Advisors (prototype name, Peas) characters that appear in Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga.

The Advisors are the Beanish servants that worship the rule of Queen Bean, and are the Beanbean Kingdom equivalents of Mushroom Retainers. When Cackletta attempted to usurp Queen Bean's rule, all the Advisors of the castle were imprisoned in the sewer system of the castle. They were saved and freed by Mario and Luigi, who defeated the possessed Queen Bean.
